name: lco-spec
description: Turn natural-language intent into schema-validated, lintable, freezable application specs — with an LLM council or a single model.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/make-bins-executable.js && node dist/schemas/export-json-schema.js
scripts.pretest: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && pnpm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build && pnpm run test
